text: A shopper with valid credentials lands on the product list.
A locked-out shopper sees an error saying the account is locked out.
Sorting by price low to high puts products in ascending price order.
The cart badge shows the number of items added to the cart.
Checkout does not continue without a postal code and tells the shopper it is required.
The order total equals the item total plus tax.
The demo account problem_user sees a different image for each product.
The shopper receives an order confirmation email after checkout.
A signed-in store manager can open the refunds page. (Manager credentials have not been provided.)
